title: 📊 Demo Monitoring Hub: Export Reports & Advanced Analytics
body:
## 📈 Advanced Demo Analytics & Reporting

### **Feature Request: Comprehensive Demo Reporting System**

Add advanced analytics and export capabilities to BuildHub AI demo monitoring for business intelligence and optimization insights.

### **Core Features:**

#### 1. **📋 Export Reports (PDF/Excel)**
- Weekly/Monthly demo performance reports
- Executive summary dashboards
- Detailed session analytics export
- Custom date range reporting
- Automated report generation and email delivery

#### 2. **🔍 Advanced Filtering & Segmentation**
```
Filters:
├── Date Range (custom, last week, month, quarter)
├── Demo Type (PL vs BE)
├── Geographic Location (country, city)
├── Session Quality (high, medium, low engagement)
├── Conversion Status (converted, bounced, in-progress)
└── User Behavior (feature heavy, casual browser, etc.)
```

#### 3. **📊 Business Intelligence Dashboard**
- ROI analysis for demo system
- Cost per demo session vs conversion value
- Feature adoption rates over time
- Seasonal demo usage patterns
- Performance benchmarking

#### 4. **⏱️ Time-series Analytics**
- Demo performance trends over time
- Week-over-week, month-over-month comparisons
- Seasonal patterns identification
- Performance anomaly detection

#### 5. **🎯 Goal Tracking & KPIs**
```
Demo KPIs:
├── Conversion Rate Target: 65% (current: 58%)
├── Average Session Duration: 8-12 minutes
├── Feature Adoption Rate: 80%+ projects module
├── Geographic Reach: 5+ countries monthly
└── Error Rate: <5% of all sessions
```

### **Advanced Analytics:**

#### 6. **🔬 Cohort Analysis**
- User behavior patterns by demo entry date
- Retention analysis for converted users
- Feature adoption progression tracking

#### 7. **🎭 A/B Testing Framework**
- Different demo flow variations
- Feature placement testing
- UI/UX optimization experiments
- Statistical significance testing

#### 8. **🌍 Geographic Intelligence**
- Country-specific demo performance
- Localization effectiveness analysis
- Regional feature preferences
- Market penetration insights

### **Technical Implementation:**
- **PDF Generation**: WeasyPrint or ReportLab
- **Excel Export**: openpyxl or xlsxwriter
- **Scheduled Reports**: Celery background tasks
- **Data Visualization**: Chart.js, D3.js integration
- **Email Delivery**: Django email with attachments

### **Report Templates:**
1. **Executive Summary** (1-page overview)
2. **Detailed Analytics** (multi-page deep dive)
3. **Geographic Report** (location-based insights)
4. **Feature Usage Report** (module adoption analysis)
5. **Performance Report** (technical metrics)

### **Business Value:**
- Data-driven demo optimization decisions
- Executive visibility into demo performance
- Automated reporting for stakeholders
- Historical trend analysis for strategic planning
- ROI justification for demo system investment

**Context:** BuildHub AI construction management demo system
**Integration:** Extend existing DemoSession/DemoActivity analytics
**Deliverables:** Professional-grade reports for business stakeholders
author: RafTurek
